phase: Phase 3: Advantage Games Completion and Scoring Contract
summary: Phase 3 Review C passes. API response shape from completeRoute.ts and recordGameCompletion matches GameCompletionResultSchema. HauntedLibraryGame onComplete UX flow uses stable per-session idempotencyKey, omits xp field, and page.tsx POSTs the full 10-field contract payload. Error responses are consistent: 400 for schema violations, 200 with duplicate:true and xpEarned:0 for fire-once duplicates. Contract types are exported via packages/domain/src/games/index.ts and the ./games subpath export. Host apps can import schema, types, XP formula, domain functions, permissions, and error classes from @reading-advantage/domain/games.
nonblocking_findings: NB-1: page.tsx handleComplete parameter type is spelled out inline rather than importing GameCompletionInput from @reading-advantage/domain/games. Phase 5+ migration can replace inline types with domain imports.

NB-2: GameEndScreen displays client-side calculateXP(gameState) preview before the async POST completes. This is documented behavior per Decision 3.5/3.7; server response is used for persistence and game store.
evidence: API response shape verified: completeRoute.ts and mutations.ts return { xpEarned: number, activityId: string, duplicate: boolean, status: 200 } matching gameCompletionResultSchema.
HauntedLibraryGame.tsx onComplete payload type has 10 fields matching GameCompletionInputSchema with no xp property. idempotencyKey generated once per session via useRef.
page.tsx POST body sends all 10 required fields and reads data.xpEarned from response for setLastResult.
Error responses: completeRoute.ts returns 400 with structured error for schema violations and invalid JSON; mutations.ts returns duplicate:true with xpEarned:0 for fire-once duplicates.

Contract exports verified: packages/domain/src/games/index.ts exports schema, types, calculateGameXP, recordGameCompletion, getGameCompletions, GAMES_PERMISSIONS, and error classes. packages/domain/package.json has ./games subpath export.
completeRoute.ts imports gameCompletionInputSchema and calculateGameXP from @reading-advantage/domain/games.
All targeted tests pass: 394 domain tests, 7 completeRoute tests, 12 HauntedLibraryGame tests. Lint and check-types clean on both filters.
commands: pnpm --filter @reading-advantage/domain test -- games => 38 files passed, 394 tests passed, 5 skipped, 0 failed
